title: Bhu-Naksha Bihar – Land Map
organization: Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms Department
vacancyDetails: Online cadastral land map and plot map services for Bihar.
qualification: Applicants with Bihar land and plot details.
selectionProcess: Select location -> Search plot -> View or download map
documentsRequired: District, circle, mauza, khata or plot details as required.
howToApply: Open Bhu-Naksha Bihar and select the location and plot details to view the map.
shortDescription: View Bihar land and plot maps through the official Bhu-Naksha portal.
content:
Bhu-Naksha Bihar provides online access to cadastral and plot maps for selected Bihar locations.

Use accurate district, circle, mauza and plot information and confirm any legal land matter with the revenue office.
